name: Woodlands Restaurant
questions: Is wheat or semolina added to your dosa/idli batter?
Is the dosa tawa shared with rava dosa?
Does the sambar contain asafoetida (hing) cut with wheat flour?
Is the vada batter pure urad dal?
quinoa_oat_flags: Ask whether any 'healthy' dosa variants contain oats (oats dosa is common in South Indian menus)

safe_dishes.note: Rice-lentil batter by tradition; confirm no semolina/wheat added

summary: A 40+ year-old Udupi place with naturally rice-based dosas; I found no gluten-free statement at all, so it's an ask-first lead.
